item.title: Rallying Cry – September 1, 2026
item.description: In exciting news, Pitso Mosimane steps into his new role with South Africa ahead of the AFCON qualifiers, a brave Perth doctor is honored for his remarkable courage, and an adorable Australian shepherd sets a world record by racing across the backs of 56 people!
